sql: select c.name, r.is_enabled, r.trigger_three_months_enabled t3, r.trigger_two_months_enabled t2, r.trigger_one_month_enabled t1, left(r.message_three_months,160) m3, left(r.message_two_months,160) m2, left(r.message_one_month,160) m1, r.eligible_statuses, r.exclude_lost, r.min_days_without_reply, r.max_daily_sends, (select count(*) from public.lead_reactivation_history h where h.company_id = r.company_id and h.status = 'sent') sent_total from public.automation_reactivation_settings r join public.companies c on c.id = r.company_id
